reviews.text: Care for your pet with skill and compassion. Bit pricey though.
Could not have asked for a better place to send a dog! So much care, attention, and Roscoe has so much fun! Daycare and boarding are both phenomenal and reasonably priced.
Just had my dog Lillie groomed by Anna, she did an amazing job! She is so kind to my dog and I so appreciate all of her hard work! This is a really great place- the people are wonderful!
I love it here! My pup goes here for daycare, boarding, and grooming. The staff is so kind and engaging with her, and most of all I trust them to take good care of her! Highly recommend!!

My dog LOVES this place, as do I. They are always so kind, thorough, and professional. The pictures/videos they upload make me so happy and confident that my dog is having a great time. 10/10 would recommend to anyone

Mac and Jason are truly wonderful…so happy we found ya’ll! Thanks to Jason for managing to wrangle our reactive dog and trim his nails! He’s a magician. And Mac always has a smile to brighten our days at the front desk.

Eddie has been a guest at Stay before and we’ve had nothing but good experiences with everyone there. Highly recommend any and all services!
Very welcoming groomers. The building is tucked in by the river. Very nice staff. Juliana cut Cookies hair. She is the best dog groomer we have been to in Chicago! Thanks all!

I am very pleased with stay dog hotel! The facilities are immaculate and they take good care of my boy ryan.he is always pulling me into the building when we visit..and the webcams are terrific to keep eyes for peace of mind! Highly reccommend!
Love this place, the atmosphere for our loved ones is great. Workers are very friendly and my dog loves them
We’ve been taking our dogs here for almost 10 years. Never had a bad experience.

We took our dogs here for 4 years for grooming and doggie daycare. The staff are so caring and always remember our dogs and us. They are very communicative at the end of each day and with the needs for our pets. JASON is the best for grooming - he always took great care for our dogs and was helpful to talk through what each dog needed for their haircut. We're so sad to be leaving the neighborhood and would reccommend this place to anyone with a fur baby!
Jason has been A++ groomer for our Wheaten and Doodle with love, care and expertise.

Great place for the dog.
Grooming service is excellent.

My dog absolutely LOVES going to Stay and I love that he's well taken care of while he's there. The staff are so friendly and attentive, they take such good care of the dogs. I recommend it to all my friends looking for doggy day care and boarding in the area. Their grooming services are also top notch!

We absolutely love using Stay for boarding our sweet pup whenever we are out of town! The staff is always so friendly and provides great updates on how your dog is doing via report cards on their website. We love that they have a huge play area for the dogs to get lots of exercise and have webcams for us to check in anytime to see how they are doing. Would happily recommend Stay to anyone looking to board their dog.

I have had overwhelmingly positive experiences with Stay, and I'm confident if my dog, Tank, could use English he'd be writing the same. I didn't plan to adopt him this spring, but the time was right for both of us. So when I found myself needing a reliable boarder to go on a three week backpacking trip I went with my partner's recommendation of Stay. Tank has a giant heart and a gentle demeanor, but he's also a 75 pound, black Pitbull, and people can jump to conclusions. The staff at Stay embraced him with open arms, and their genuine concern for his well being and comfort have been evident on every visit. They are communicative and transparent, and the detailed and creative report cards they sent during boarding took away any worry I might have had. I will certainly be returning on a regular basis for daycare and for future boarding needs.
